We provide modern accommodations, friendly service, and amenities like an indoor pool and gym, along with free WiFi and breakfast. Those here for work can also make use of our business center. While you're visiting, explore the Columbus Zoo and Aquarium, Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens, Bicentennial Park, and more. Refreshing Amenities Settle in with free continental breakfast and WiFi, a pool, and gym A bright stay awaits at our hotel in Columbus. With amenities like our on-site fitness center, indoor pool, and business center, you'll have everything you need for a great trip. Get energized with our free continental Bright Side Breakfast®. Pet-friendly rooms are available for an extra nightly fee. Discover Columbus Explore parks, hit the casino, or visit the arts district During your stay with us in Columbus, you'll never run out of things to do. Enjoy a number of parks in the city, like Bicentennial Park or the Park of Roses, visit the Columbus Zoo and Aquarium, or explore the Center of Science and Industry (COSI). Those who love art can also spend time at the Short North Arts District. Plus, if you're feeling lucky, our hotel is only five miles from Hollywood Casino Columbus.
